assertions.evidence: The code ranks in code via rankDuplicates, mapping noul probabilities and sorting: `.map(... { ticketId, probability: answer.noul } ).sort((a, b) => b.probability - a.probability)`.
The workflow handles no-duplicate cases with `if (!top || top.probability < REVIEW_THRESHOLD) { return { action: "no_confident_duplicate", ranked }; }`.
